scope: 動的Li Chao Treeの次にDynamicUnionFindの2周目を比較。main・共通I/O・処理順は固定。

environment.clock: 固定せず。コア別lock、交互/乱択順、同一baseline実行binarycontrol。

hash_salt_method: 通常版はprocessごと時計からsaltを選ぶため同一binarycontrolも数%以上変動する。補足ではtmp本体のinitial_saltだけbaseline/候補とも同じ3定数へ変更して比較し、通常版の記録と区別する。productionへ定数saltや設定マクロは追加しない。

decisions.root_parent: 親値保持/2段展開の2案。通常salt公式18件×7rep、安定した短縮なし。2段展開はmax_random3件で約5〜9%増。同一binarycontrolのsalt変動もあり、個別の微差を確定的な効果と扱わない。
decisions.readonly_cache: 密なintキー範囲のidキャッシュを登録数の2倍/8倍範囲内で作る2案。全intキー・領域上限・例外・コピーを保持するが、fixed saltでもpath約8〜11%、一部random約10%後退し不採用。
decisions.hybrid: 密な範囲内の新規キーはhashへ書かず配列で保持し、外側はhashのまま扱う1案。18ケース中央値合計は約11%短縮したが、fixed-saltの短いdense入力約6〜9%、大規模sparse約1〜4%後退が残るため不採用。
decisions.paired_lookup: 2キーのprobeを交互に進める/先頭slotで両方一致すれば即返す2案。通常saltの公式18件×warmup1+7rep、補足3固定saltの6代表ケース×7repで正解一致。交互probeの大規模改善は約0〜2%で他条件は同等〜微増、slot短絡案は約1〜3%後退。共有Hashへの追加APIとコード量を正当化する安定した広い改善を確認できず不採用。
decisions.production: 本体・公開API・所有権・main/I/O・使用例・Documentは維持。既存InternalHashMapのSIMD rehashもそのまま。追加SIMDや設定マクロはない。

roots/decision.json.candidate_scope: root_index only; exact baseline path-halving writes and order retained
roots/decision.json.method: 1 warmup + 7 interleaved repetitions of all 4 executables per official input; input bytes read before timer; elapsed includes subprocess overhead; outputs compared exactly
roots/decision.json.conclusion: 不採用。親値を保持する候補は同一バイナリ対照の揺れを超える安定した短縮がなく、2段展開はmax_random 3件全てで後退。API大規模性能測定には進まず、本体を変更しない。
roots/decision.json.shortcut_note: ix==iy の無条件短絡は既存の経路半減を省き data() が返す親キーを変える可能性があるため、この候補には含めなかった。
roots/decision.json.simd_note: root_index は直前のロード結果から次の親添字を決める依存連鎖。mainを一括化せずに複数経路を並列gatherする根拠がなく、SIMD候補を追加していない。

dense/hybrid_validation.json.sanitizer_limitation: Default LeakSanitizer failed because ptrace is active in execution environment; reran with leak detector disabled. Tests also count live allocations independently and ended at zero delta.

# DynamicUnionFind hybrid interval/hash map: screen complete

Repository unmodified. Readonly cache variants are rejected and preserved in `report_readonly.md`, `readonly_8n.hpp`, `readonly_8n.diff`, `*_readonly_8n.json`, and `candidate_2n.*`.

## Hybrid design

`hybrid.hpp` SHA-256 `71a127a7076d6c778c0dcae1272faf5a2f1102a6c7f6f4f686bdad60872538dd`, diff `hybrid.diff`. Baseline SHA-256 `1b5e97ee931f3f50c671c12f2afc26cb77fdcd66b956cea115d5cc103cd188ea`.

Dense interval lookup vector and baseline hash jointly represent the exact key->node-index map. New in-range keys append Node then commit cache slot and component count; they do not insert into hash. Out-of-range registration uses baseline hash. Old hash entries are retained after rebuilding the interval. Rebuild fills every node, so active in-range slot is authoritative. New node push failure leaves registration unchanged. Cache allocation failure and excessive global key span preserve the previous vector because it can own keys absent from hash. Empty cache uses an early branch to avoid offset arithmetic on sparse repeated lookups.

Reconsider interval at 64,128,256,... registered nodes. Global span must fit min(8N,1Mi). Cache slot count=min(2*bit_ceil(span),bit_floor(min(8N,1Mi))); skip if this is smaller than span. Thus there is room for online growth beyond the current span. Starting key is global min, clamped down near INT_MAX so every slot corresponds to a valid int. Arithmetic uses int64/uint64. No problem n, input batching, or main changes. Existing APIs/representative keys/data layout are unchanged.

Cache vector persistent storage<=4MiB and <=32N bytes, 32 additional instance bytes on x86-64, transient rebuild vectors<=8MiB. Copy duplicates this storage. Cached new registrations reduce hash allocations/work. Rebuild scans and initializes O(N) amortized total at doubling registration counts; extra cache memory remains O(N). Clear resets both maps and retains capacity like baseline. Reserve retains baseline capacity reservation semantics. Copy/move/assignment preserve both maps. Failed optional growth preserves existing lookup ownership.

## Performance screen

`/usr/bin/g++`15.2.0, `-std=c++23 -O2 -march=native`, SKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS, CPU6 compilation; CPU12 measurement under shared `/tmp/sirkit_performance_cpu12.lock`. Same repository Verify driver/main and common fast_io. Control is the exact baseline binary. Alternating interleaved order. Every output compared exactly. Official fixtures `/tmp/sirkit_duf_20261022/official`.

`official_benchmark_hybrid.json`:18 official cases,7 reps each using ordinary process-clock salt. Nonexample median-sum baseline173.782ms/control173.264ms/hybrid154.129ms (~11.1% improvement). Maxrandom ratios0.823/0.951/0.839; path0/1 ratios1.001/1.018 and path2/3 ratios0.810/0.859. Random cases mostly0.784–0.911 but short random03=1.125/random07=1.070. These are per-process salted results and have noise.

Supplement `fixedsalt_benchmark_hybrid.json`:baseline/candidate initial_salt only replaced with the same3 constants,5 reps each, same real driver. Ratios:

| Case | Hybrid/baseline |
|---|---|
| max_random_00 | 0.839–0.867 |
| max_random_01 | 0.893–0.963 |
| path_00 | 1.004–1.019 |
| path_02 | 0.849,1.208,0.850 |
| random_03 | 1.063–1.086 |
| 200k-key,2m-query dense | 0.902–0.912 |
| same sparse key permutation | 1.014–1.036 |

Path02 middle salt crosses a CPU performance regime during its5 reps (baseline/control~10ms early/~14ms late). This raw record is retained; a13rep repeat for that same salt gives baseline13.637ms/control13.650ms/hybrid11.994ms (ratio0.8795), all stable, in `hybrid_repeat_path.json`.

Normal-salt large diagnostics in `diagnostic_benchmark_hybrid.json` also show dense improvement but large sparse baseline/control variation; fixed-salt sparse is more meaningful. Dense/sparse diagnostics have identical seeded operations,200000 keys,2000000 operations; dense keys[-100000,99999], sparse odd multiplication modulo2^32 over same indices. No key-range information is passed to the class.

Hybrid is materially faster on most official dense workloads, unlike the rejected readonly cache. Short dense workloads regress6–9% with fixed salt, and sparse workloads regress1–4%, plus additional memory/state. Adoption is left to root's overall comparison; this is not an unconditional speed improvement.

## Correctness

All18 official outputs pass exactly. `dense_api_test.cpp` extends existing independent Reference-label tests with active-cache ownership, near INT_MIN/INT_MAX ranges, outliers, copy/move/assignment/clear/reserve, failed direct registration, copy allocation failures, and optional interval rebuild failure after old interval already owns hash-absent keys. Checked native and SKIP standard/no-SIMD builds pass651246 checks,31 allocation failure points,live allocation delta0 each. Earlier nativeSKIP build passed646746 checks before the4500 extra optional-growth-failure checks. Additional sanitizer status is recorded separately after completion.

ASan+UBSan SKIP build also passes651246 checks/31 failure points/live delta0, with `ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0`. Default LeakSanitizer cannot run under the environment's ptrace; the independent allocation counter still reports live delta0. Structured status `hybrid_validation.json`.
reproduction.readonly_report:
# DynamicUnionFind adaptive dense lookup cache: reject

Repository files were not modified. Work stayed in this directory.

Baseline SHA-256: `1b5e97ee931f3f50c671c12f2afc26cb77fdcd66b956cea115d5cc103cd188ea`.

## Candidate

`readonly_8n.hpp`: hash map remains canonical for every registered key; a separate interval vector maps integer keys to internal node indices. Empty construction allocates nothing. At registration counts 64,128,256,..., scan existing node keys for min/max. Enable/rebuild if span<=8N and span<=1,048,576 slots; otherwise disable lookup vector. For an active interval, registered keys directly access index; holes/outside use canonical hash, and successful insertion fills in-range slots. Sparse candidates are reconsidered only at doubling counts, so scans total O(N). No problem-size knowledge or main changes. `candidate_2n.hpp` is the first span<=2N variant.

All int keys including INT_MIN/INT_MAX use widened signed subtraction and unsigned64 bounds checking. Copy/move/assignment/clear maintain cache state. Optional cache allocation catches bad_alloc, drops the cache, and keeps semantic registration intact. Callback roots/data are untouched. Canonical insertion retains its baseline exception behavior.

Persistent cache storage <=4MiB and <=32N bytes at 8N density threshold, plus 32 bytes instance state on this x86-64 target. Rebuild can transiently retain old+new vectors (<=8MiB). Cache capacity remains reusable after clear/disable, like the baseline hash/node capacity. Canonical hash storage is retained, so this is additional memory. Active dense repeated lookup avoids hash work; sparse/registration operations gain branches, and periodic builds add scans/initialization.

## Conditions

Compiler `/usr/bin/g++` 15.2.0; `-std=c++23 -O2 -march=native`; SKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS; compile pinned CPU6. Performance runs CPU12 under `/tmp/sirkit_performance_cpu12.lock`. Same repository `Verify/current/drivers/dynamic_union_find_main.cpp` and common fast_io for baseline/candidate. The control invocation uses the exact baseline binary. Interleaved order alternates each repetition. All timed outputs compared exactly.

Official 18 fixture inputs/outputs: `/tmp/sirkit_duf_20261022/official`, originally generated from the official Library Checker unionfind sources. 7 repetitions for normal process-clock salt. `official_benchmark_2n.json` retains first variant; `official_benchmark_readonly_8n.json` is 8N. Normal salt has substantial per-process noise; official 8N path medians regressed 8–11%, with mixed random results.

Diagnostics `dense.in` and `sparse.in`: same 2,000,000 online operations, 200,000 keys, deterministic seed20261028. Dense keys are [-100000,99999]; sparse keys apply an odd multiplication modulo2^32 and signed conversion. Fixed main ignores diagnostic n as it does official n. 7 repetitions with normal salt: dense baseline116.84ms/control114.31ms/candidate99.90ms; sparse159.95/159.16/152.46ms (salt noise).

To isolate salt, supplementary headers change only initial_salt to the same three odd 64-bit constants in both baseline/candidate. Same main/IO/settings and 5 repetitions each. Raw records `fixedsalt_benchmark_readonly_8n.json`:

| Case | Candidate / baseline across 3 fixed salts |
|---|---|
| max_random_00 | 0.9858–0.9895 |
| max_random_01 | 1.0126–1.0260 |
| path_00 | 1.0926–1.1061 |
| path_02 | 1.0840–1.0862 |
| random_03 | 1.0974–1.1299 |
| dense diagnostic | 0.8815–0.8854 |
| sparse diagnostic | 1.0123–1.0156 |

Fixed-salt same-binary controls are generally within 1%. This cache helps query-heavy dense intervals by about11.5–11.8%, but robustly regresses official path/random cases by8–13% and sparse diagnostic by1.2–1.6%. Reject general adoption.

## Correctness

All 18 official outputs pass for both variants. Existing repository DynamicUnionFind tests pass checked and SKIP builds:601235 checks,31 allocation failure points,live allocation delta0 each. Extended `dense_api_test.cpp` adds active-cache copy/move/assignment/clear/reserve behavior, near INT_MIN/INT_MAX dense ranges, outliers, failed insertion and copy assignment:646746 checks,31 allocation failure points,live delta0 for both modes.

Final portability guards use uint64 for density products and check vector max_size; measured x86-64 executable `.text` is identical before/after that final guard adjustment, SHA-256 `e19795ba5ee59db2a2291f089d28ff2ea586b007f234c577c2bafb5682c035e6`. No sanitizer run was required for adoption because the candidate is rejected; API tests above were completed.

Raw headers and unified diffs: `readonly_8n.hpp`, `readonly_8n.diff`, `candidate_2n.hpp`, `candidate_2n.diff`. Final 8N header SHA-256 `6380c1ac88cbcd336ff6bb728e306b1f62397cf596e6d0a49e03f8294c254155`; 2N header `cdc57e769d559458ece5113feed0f6f78e9bbc4e60dd7b2a5bbb960987363c76`.

limits: 公式中央値の合計は特定ケース集合の集計であり、全ての使い方の平均速度ではない。小規模だけの許容された後退と、大規模sparseの後退を混同しない。全入力/全CPUでの最適性や旧23msをさらに短縮したことは主張しない。
